translations.literal: Only in the supplementary provisions did it say that China's religion follows Confucius and that the bonds of human relations and ritual instruction are paramount.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the supplementary provisions did it say that China's religion follows Confucius and that the bonds of human relations and ritual instruction weigh most heavily.

sentences.zh: 如律中十惡親屬容隱，干名犯義，存留養親，及親屬相奸、相盜、相毆，發冢犯奸各條，未便蔑棄。

translations.literal: Such articles in the code as concealment by relatives among the Ten Abominations, offenses against names and violation of righteousness, remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery, theft, and assault among relatives, and grave-robbing adultery—these should not lightly be cast aside.
translations.idiomatic: Such articles in the code as concealment by relatives among the Ten Abominations, offenses against names and violation of righteousness, remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery, theft, and assault among relatives, and grave-robbing adultery ought not to be cast aside lightly.

sentences.zh: 中國人有犯以上各罪，應仍依舊律，別輯單行法，以昭懲創。

translations.literal: When Chinese commit the above crimes, they should still be judged under the old code, compiled separately as a special law, to manifest punishment and deterrence.
translations.idiomatic: When Chinese commit the above crimes, they should still be judged under the old code in a separately compiled special law, to make punishment and deterrence clear.

sentences.zh: 竊維修訂新律，本為籌備立憲，統一法權。

translations.literal: I respectfully consider that revising the new code was originally meant to prepare for constitutionalism and unify legal authority.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully consider that revising the new code was originally intended to prepare for constitutional government and unify legal authority.

sentences.zh: 凡中國人及在中國居住之外國人，皆應服從同一法律。

translations.literal: All Chinese and all foreigners residing in China should obey the same law.
translations.idiomatic: All Chinese and all foreigners residing in China should be subject to the same law.

sentences.zh: 是此法律，本當以治中國人為主。

translations.literal: This law should primarily govern Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: This law should chiefly govern the Chinese.

sentences.zh: 今乃依舊律別輯中國人單行法，是視此新刑律專為外國人設矣。

translations.literal: Now to compile a separate special law for Chinese under the old code is to treat this new penal code as designed exclusively for foreigners.
translations.idiomatic: Now to compile a separate special law for Chinese under the old code is to treat this new penal code as if it were made exclusively for foreigners.

sentences.zh: 本末倒置，莫此為甚。

translations.literal: To invert root and branch—nothing could be more extreme than this.
translations.idiomatic: To invert root and branch—nothing could be more perverse.

sentences.zh: 草案案語謂修訂刑律，所以收回領事裁判權。

translations.literal: The draft's commentary says that revising the penal code is for reclaiming consular jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The draft's commentary says that revising the penal code is meant to reclaim consular jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 刑律內有一二條為外國人所不遵奉，即無收回裁判權之實。

translations.literal: If one or two articles in the penal code are not observed by foreigners, there is in fact no reclaiming of judicial authority.
translations.idiomatic: If foreigners refuse to observe even one or two articles in the penal code, there is in reality no reclaiming of judicial authority.

sentences.zh: 故所修刑律，專以摹仿外國為事。

translations.literal: Therefore the revised penal code devotes itself exclusively to imitating foreign countries.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the revised penal code has devoted itself exclusively to imitating foreign countries.

sentences.zh: 此說實不盡然。

translations.literal: This claim is not entirely true.
translations.idiomatic: This claim is not entirely accurate.

sentences.zh: 泰西各國，凡外國人居其國中，無不服從其國法律，不得執本國無此律以相爭，亦不得恃本國有此律以相抗。

translations.literal: In all Western countries, whatever foreigners reside in their lands must obey the laws of those lands; they may not argue that their own country has no such law, nor rely on their own country having such a law to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In all Western countries, foreigners residing within their borders must obey the laws of those countries; they may neither argue that their own country has no such law nor rely on their own country's law to resist.

sentences.zh: 今中國修訂刑律，乃謂為收回領事裁判權，必盡舍固有之禮教風俗，一一摹仿外國。

translations.literal: Now in revising China's penal code, one says that to reclaim consular jurisdiction one must entirely abandon inherent ritual instruction and customs and imitate foreign countries one by one.
translations.idiomatic: Now, in revising China's penal code, it is said that to reclaim consular jurisdiction one must wholly abandon China's own ritual instruction and customs and imitate foreign countries one by one.

sentences.zh: 則同乎此國者，彼國有違言，同乎彼國者，此國又相反，是必窮之道也。

translations.literal: Then what accords with this country, that country will object to; what accords with that country, this country will oppose—the way of certain exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Then whatever matches this country, that country will reject; whatever matches that country, this country will reject—a path that can only end in deadlock.

sentences.zh: 總之一國之律，必與各國之律相同，然後乃能令國內居住之外國人遵奉，萬萬無此理，亦萬萬無此事。

translations.literal: In sum, that one country's laws must be identical with every other country's laws before foreigners residing within can be made to obey—there is absolutely no such principle, and absolutely no such possibility.
translations.idiomatic: In short, the notion that one country's laws must be identical with every other country's laws before foreigners residing within can be made to obey them is utterly without principle and utterly impossible.

sentences.zh: 以此為收回領事裁判權之策，是終古無收回之望也。

translations.literal: To take this as the strategy for reclaiming consular jurisdiction is to have no hope of reclaiming it through all time.
translations.idiomatic: To take this as the strategy for reclaiming consular jurisdiction is to abandon all hope of ever reclaiming it.

sentences.zh: 且夫國之有刑，所以弼教。

translations.literal: Moreover, a state has punishments in order to assist instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, a state maintains punishments in order to assist moral instruction.

sentences.zh: 一國之民有不遵禮教者，以刑齊之。

translations.literal: When the people of a state do not observe ritual instruction, punishments are used to bring them into alignment.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of a state fail to observe ritual instruction, punishments are used to bring them into line.

sentences.zh: 所謂禮防未然，刑禁已然，相輔而行，不可缺一者也。

translations.literal: What is called ritual guarding against what has not yet happened and punishments restraining what has already happened—they proceed in mutual assistance and neither may be lacking.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by saying that ritual guards against what has not yet happened and punishments restrain what has already happened: the two assist each other, and neither can be dispensed with.

sentences.zh: 故各省簽駁草案，每以維持風化立論，而案語乃指為渾道德法律為一。

translations.literal: Therefore the various provinces, in annotating objections to the draft, often argued from maintaining public morals, yet the commentary denounced this as conflating morality and law into one.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, when the various provinces annotated objections to the draft, they often argued from the need to uphold public morals, yet the commentary denounced this as conflating morality and law.

translations.idiomatic: Its discussion of adultery without a husband says: "When the state makes laws, it expects them to be enforced and obeyed.

sentences.zh: 有法而不能行，轉使民玩法而肆無忌憚。

translations.literal: When there is law but it cannot be enforced, it only makes the people treat the law as a game and act without restraint.
translations.idiomatic: When laws exist but cannot be enforced, the people treat the law as a game and act without restraint.

sentences.zh: 和姦之事，幾于禁之無可禁，誅之不勝誅，即刑章具在，亦祗具文。

translations.idiomatic: In cases of consensual adultery, prohibition is nearly impossible and punishment cannot keep pace; even when the penal code is complete, it remains only words on paper.

translations.literal: Only when education is widespread, households are strict, the force of public opinion is strong, and a sense of shame arises can the tide of debauchery somewhat abate.
translations.idiomatic: Only when education is widespread, households are strict, public opinion is strong, and a sense of shame takes root can the tide of debauchery begin to recede.

translations.idiomatic: Even if such conduct were made the subject of separate articles, there would be no practical effect.

translations.idiomatic: The next year the Advisory Council convened; the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted the draft to the council for deliberation, and the General Provisions were passed.
